newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israel's Netanyahu to meet Egypt's Mubarak.
newsitem.headline: Israel's Netanyahu to meet Egypt's Mubarak.

text.p: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu will visit Cairo on Wednesday for talks with Egyptian President Hosni Mubarak, Netanyahu's office said on Sunday.

A spokeswoman in Netanyahu's office confirmed a report by Israel's Itim news agency that said Netanyahu would meet with Mubarak and was taking a delegation of Israeli business executives with him. She gave no other details.
The visit will come exactly a week after Israel's decision to build a 6,500-unit settlement for Jews in Arab East Jerusalem that has outraged Palestinians and sparked international criticism.
Mubarak and Palestinian President Yasser Arafat discussed the Israeli plan in Cairo on Saturday. Egypt's foreign minister said Israel's settlement policy could only lead to destruction.

Wednesday's meeting will be the third time Netanyahu and Mubarak have met since the Israeli prime minister took office in June. Netanyahu first visited Cairo in July. They next met at the international economic forum in Davos in February.
